text:
zoe-cs: FYI HelixGen wants their dedicated pool live Wed 06:00 UTC. They provided steady ~650 rps, scheduled training bursts to 2200 rps (90s), avg tokens ~310. Need final quota, autoscale rules, and a pre-cutover smoke test. Who takes infra and SRE?

matt-infra: I can do provisioning + quota. Ask: do they expect embedding-heavy windows? if yes we should reserve extra mem for emb workers.

zoe-cs: Yes ~12% embeddings, mostly during nightly transforms. They also want VPC peering and customer-managed certs.

choi-sre: Autoscale suggestion: min=2 nodes, max=12, scale up +3 when GPU_util>72% for 45s; scale down -2 after 3m. Add a safety fast-fail route: when error_rate>0.8% for 1m, flip non-critical traffic to hosted fallback.

ana-cs: (typo) sorry, ana-cs: I'll run customer-facing smoke and UX checks. Plan: shadow dry-run 48h prior + full dry-run 6h prior. I'll prepare a 25-prompt eval set focusing on edge-case prompts.

ops-bot: Ticket opened CS-8233 HelixGen dedicated bring-up - owners: matt-infra, choi-sre, ana-cs - dry-run (shadow) 2024-11-08T06:00:00Z.

sam-pm: One constraint: legal asked if SLA exposure for training bursts changes renewal terms. Zoe, flag renewal risk if post-cutover error >1.5% for 48h.

matt-infra: Terraform snippet (posting minimal example):
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "helixgen" {
  name       = "helixgen-pool"
  region     = "eu-central-1"
  min_nodes  = 2
  max_nodes  = 12
  gpu_type   = "g5x.2"
  reserved_tokens_per_min = 130000
}
```

choi-sre: Pre-warm plan: replay 8k recent prefixes + run KV-warm step. Load plan (phased):
- warm (10m) at 250rps
- soak (20m) at 650rps with eval probes every 4m
- burst test: 4x spikes to 2400 rps (90s hold)
I'll run from our k8s runner. Use this k6 command for the soak: 
```
k6 run --vus 120 --duration 20m tests/helixgen_soak.js --out json=helixgen_soak.json
```

ana-cs: I'll attach the eval harness to CS-8233. Thresholds: semantic-similarity drop >6% or hallucination rate increase >2% = stop the run.

zoe-cs: Fallback routing: route analytics and non-urgent batch to hosted-small model with rate-limit 40% of baseline; keep conversational flow on dedicated. We'll also surface a "degraded" flag via webhook to customer.

matt-infra: KMS note: HelixGen needs HSM-backed keys. I'm coordinating the KMS binding; expecting wrap-up 36h before cutover. Posting the KMS checklist link in ticket.

sam-pm: Owners recap: matt=infra/KMS/quota, choi=load-tests/autoscale tuning, ana=QA/smoke + customer dry-run, zoe=customer comms + go/no-go. Dry-run timeline: shadow 2024-11-06 06:00Z, full 2024-11-08 00:00Z (6h pre-cutover).

zoe-cs: Action items: matt post terraform + KMS status, choi push k6 scripts and initial baseline numbers, ana upload eval set, I'll confirm windows with customer and send calendar invites. Ping on slack if any blocker. :white_check_mark:
